selection_scope: Human convenience API engineering adoption based on H3 owner P50 observations and exact native-call/provider/C++new equality; not a universal zero-overhead or no-tail-regression claim.
key_counterevidence: H1 and H2 owner read/write P50 regressions remain fully retained, independently audited and not selected.
H3 System whole-read wall P95 paired median is 1.128761437386931 with +28.80859375 ns/op and six of eight unfavorable pairs; both halves and both order strata remain above one.
H3 Arena subrange-write wall P95 paired median is 1.1035943704979005 with +17.822265625 ns/op and six of eight unfavorable pairs; both halves and both order strata remain above one.
H3 System and Arena whole-write wall P50 paired medians are above one, with five of eight unfavorable pairs each.
Whole-flow and hot timings are separately retained; count equality does not imply timing equality.
rules: All ratio/delta summaries derive from each round own manual/helper pairs from one executable and core binding.
No values are pooled across rounds, no cross-round unpaired ratio division is used to quantify a net optimization.
Cold denotes a fresh one-operation domain after four warmups, not process/OS cold startup.
Configuration fields are observed in count forwarding targets; raw expected labels are not additional observations.
Codegen direct-call removal and .text size are separate evidence and do not prove universal timing parity.
The source snapshots for H1, H2 and H3 remain exact; current repository contents are not substituted for historical headers.
